about: Written by registry.py on every build (ledger.update) and rebuilt from git by python ledger.py --backfill; docs/data-management.md. first_published never moves; last_updated is the date of the build (or, before 2026-10-19, of the merge into main) that last changed the file's content hash; versions counts the content versions published. Dates are Puerto Rico dates (UTC-4). On a merge conflict, take main's version of this file and run python registry.py.
